name: @radarclip/player
description: Canvas player for radarclip/1 clips: RadarclipPlayer API and <radarclip-player> element

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/radarclip-player.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Radarclip --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/radarclip-player.iife.js
